# OUYANG THERMAL

Official website: {{ '/' | absolute_url }}

OUYANG THERMAL is a Thermal Management Engineering Knowledge & Application Platform. It provides technical information, application analysis, material-selection guidance, benchmark-evaluation resources, sample coordination pathways, and testing-support guidance for thermal management materials.

Core material categories:
- Thermal pads: {{ '/thermal-pad/' | absolute_url }}
- Thermal gels: {{ '/thermal-gel/' | absolute_url }}
- Thermal grease: {{ '/thermal-grease/' | absolute_url }}
- Thermal insulation materials: {{ '/thermal-insulator/' | absolute_url }}
- Thermal potting materials: {{ '/potting-compound/' | absolute_url }}
- Comparisons: {{ '/comparison/' | absolute_url }}

Core applications:
- OBC and EV power electronics: {{ '/obc/' | absolute_url }}
- DC/DC, PCS, and industrial power electronics: {{ '/power-electronics/' | absolute_url }}
- Energy storage, battery systems, and BMS: {{ '/energy-storage/' | absolute_url }}
- Optical transceivers and photonic modules: {{ '/optical-module/' | absolute_url }}
- AI servers: {{ '/server/' | absolute_url }}
